scope: Additive Dragon Duke Fire Heart L1-18 May 2026 balance, regeneration and on-defeat burst audit.
game_version: Official May 2026 balance; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: State of Gameplay - Part 2
facts: Official table changes Fire Heart DPS bonus at all L1-18 to 10,10,12,12,12,14,14,14,16,16,16,18,18,18,20,20,20,23.
Regeneration changes L15 from 155 to 140 and L18 from 175 to 150.
sources.limitations: The table does not give post-change regeneration for L16-17, on-defeat burst values, target classes, radius geometry or tick order.

sources.title: Fire Heart — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated L1-18 DPS table matches the official May 2026 replacement values; HP bonus remains 900-5600.
sources.limitations: No current regeneration or death burst level table or fixed-tick mechanics is published.

sources.title: Pinned Fire Heart Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned description says Dragon Duke slowly regenerates HP and bursts into damaging flames on defeat; radius label is 4 tiles.
Historical pinned L1-18 death damage is 1000-3000, regeneration is 50-175 per second, and DPS bonus is 10-45.
sources.limitations: Pinned DPS bonuses at L2-18 and regeneration at L15/L18 predate the official May 2026 reduction; current burst values and deterministic ordering are unverified.

derivations.result: Official May 2026 DPS series supersedes pinned DPS series for all levels; official regeneration supersedes pinned values at L15 and L18 only
derivations.method: Compare each pinned level against the official old/new table, then corroborate new DPS series with the dated 2026 client table. Preserve the frozen raw file and record replacements only in this delta.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use frozen raw DPS bonuses L2-18 in combat
rejected_inferences.reason: The official May 2026 table explicitly supersedes them.

rejected_inferences.rule: Set regeneration at L16/L17 to 140 by propagating the L15 balance value
rejected_inferences.reason: The official table names only L15 and L18; intermediate current values are not given.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply 1000-3000 burst damage at the Duke's death tick to every entity within four center-distance tiles
rejected_inferences.reason: Current burst values, eligibility, radius metric, simultaneous death ordering and damage stage are not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply regeneration as a floating health delta each render frame
rejected_inferences.reason: Combat requires fixed 10 ms integer ticks; healing accumulation and rounding are not specified.

items: current regeneration at L16-17 and death burst damage/radius continuity
integer healing accrual, max HP cap and first/last heal tick
death burst trigger, delay, target classes, radius geometry and kill order
interaction with Duke trap mitigation, other Equipment, Pets and simultaneous damage
Viewer burst and heal effects, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Fire Heart L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official May 2026 DPS bonuses and L15/L18 regeneration replacements are recorded without altering the frozen reference. Current L16/L17 regeneration, death burst values and deterministic healing, radius and death ordering remain unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
